messages:
Nina K: quick perf note from a 100k short-request replay: host-side CPU is the dominant p50 cost for seq <= 64.
Eli W: numbers?
Nina K: p50 total 11ms, GPU decode 3.7ms, host 6.6ms. host breakdown: tokenization=2.7ms, parse/proto=1.4ms, writev/syscalls=1.1ms, http2/gRPC framing=0.8ms.
Samir: runtime kernel chooser still prefers MEDIUM for many small sequences. propose fast-small kernel path for <=64.
Nina K: prototyped histogram-driven selector that prefers KERNEL_SMALL when recent window majority <=64. p50 host dropped ~0.6ms in quick run.
Eli W: tokenization cache for templated prompts looks promising. cache tokenized prefixes per-tenant with model-version pin. watch memory + invalidation.
Samir: kvcache note: saw eviction storms when a template goes hot -> lots of evictions + thrash. mitigation: per-shard admission caps + probabilistic TTL jitter (base_ttl*(1+rand(-0.2,0.2))).
Nina K: grpc streaming micro-opt: coalesce small chunks for up to 1.5ms or until 4KB. make adaptive: bypass when client SLO <= 20ms. observed syscalls down ~40%, host CPU down ~0.7ms p50.
ops-bot: Canary scheduled -> canary-14, targets=canary-pool-6, changes=[kernel-small, token-prefix-cache, grpc-coalesce-adaptive], duration=2h, monitor=[latency_p50/p95, host_cpu, syscalls, kv_evictions].
Samir: I'll own kvcache changes + hot-shard telemetry.
Eli W: I'll implement parser fast-path for header-flagged tokenized payloads and add unit tests.
Nina K: I'll coordinate canary, collect flamegraphs + syscall traces, and post results. filing PRs behind feature flags now. :thumbsup:
